name: Balance Studios
description: Join us for 7 days free in Gracie Brazilian Jiu Jitsu and Muay Thai Boxing classes in Center City, Northeast and Fishtown Philadelphia.

items.title: Migliarese Bros
items.text: Balance Studios is a multiple award winner of “Best of Philly” and the leading source of instruction in Gracie Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ), Mixed Martial Arts, Muay Thai Kickboxing, Kids Martial Arts, and Women’s Self Defense in Philadelphia.

items.title: Gracie Family Approved
items.text: Balance Studios is a family-focused studio, prioritizing a positive atmosphere. Our level-specific Muay Thai and Gracie Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu courses are designed for beginners, ensuring a comfortable learning experience with peers of similar skill level.
